WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bbs.match_id,
        bbs.over_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(bbs.runs_scored), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) as total_runs
    FROM batsman_scored bbs
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bbs.match_id = er.match_id 
        AND bbs.over_id = er.over_id 
        AND bbs.ball_id = er.ball_id 
    GROUP BY bbs.match_id, bbs.over_id
),
first_ball_bowler AS (
    SELECT match_id, over_id, bowler
    FROM ball_by_ball
    WHERE ball_id = 1
),
over_runs_with_bowler AS (
    SELECT 
        or_data.match_id,
        or_data.over_id,
        or_data.total_runs,
        fb.bowler
    FROM over_runs or_data
    JOIN first_ball_bowler fb ON or_data.match_id = fb.match_id AND or_data.over_id = fb.over_id
),
max_over_per_match AS (
    SELECT 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY total_runs DESC, over_id) as rn,
        match_id,
        total_runs,
        bowler
    FROM over_runs_with_bowler
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as total_matches,
    AVG(total_runs) as average_highest_over_runs,
    MIN(total_runs) as min_highest_over,
    MAX(total_runs) as max_highest_over
FROM (
    SELECT match_id, total_runs
    FROM max_over_per_match
    WHERE rn = 1
)
